categories.main_business_segments: CALB Group Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, manufacturing, and sales of lithium batteries, battery management systems, and related integrated products, focusing on EV batteries and energy storage system (ESS) products. The company serves multiple markets including passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, energy storage, marine vessels, and emerging sectors like low-altitude economy and rail transit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced battery technologies including high-voltage lithium nickel manganese oxide materials, ultra-fast charging LFP batteries, high-nickel cylindrical batteries, and all-solid-state batteries. It employs advanced manufacturing techniques such as thick electrode manufacturing, fast-charging core-making technology, AI-based big data platforms for process optimization, and full life cycle battery management using virtual measurement and big data analytics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CALB serves OEMs in the new energy vehicle sector including passenger and commercial vehicles, with strategic customers like XPeng, Geely, Changan, and international brands such as Toyota and Volkswagen. It also supplies large-scale energy storage projects, power groups, system integrators, and marine vessel operators, including international commercial ship projects and high-end yachts in the US.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Mainland China, which accounts for over 97% of its revenue, with growing international presence in Europe, Southeast Asia, the US, and emerging markets such as the Middle East, Latin America, and South Africa. It has established production bases and R&D centers in China and overseas locations including Germany, Singapore, Portugal, and Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: CALB operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell production, battery pack integration, and system solutions for EVs and energy storage. It also engages in upstream research and development of battery materials through its subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in advanced materials, high-performance battery technologies, new battery types like all-solid-state batteries, and advanced manufacturing processes. It emphasizes digital intelligence integration in R&D and manufacturing, lifecycle battery management, and sustainability aligned with carbon neutrality goals by 2030-2040. Internationalization and expansion into new markets and applications are also key strategic directions.
categories.revenue_model: CALB generates revenue primarily through product sales of EV batteries and ESS products. The revenue mix includes sales to automotive OEMs, energy storage system integrators, and commercial customers. The company also explores innovative business models such as self-invested power station projects and comprehensive energy storage solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks fourth globally and third domestically in EV battery installed capacity and fifth globally in energy storage cell shipments. It competes with major battery manufacturers like CATL, which has filed intellectual property claims against CALB. CALB positions itself as a technology leader with a strong patent portfolio and product innovation to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CALB reported revenue of RMB 27.75 billion, a 2.8% increase year-on-year, with profit for the year rising 93% to RMB 843.6 million. Total assets reached RMB 122.47 billion, up 16.2%, supported by significant capital expenditures in production capacity expansion. The company has a growing international footprint and sustained growth in ESS business, despite a slight decline in EV battery revenue due to price decreases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CALB emphasizes delivering premium, reliable batteries with cutting-edge technology, balancing energy density, safety, lifespan, and fast charging capabilities. Its differentiated products include 'Top-tier', 'UltraRange', 'UltraLife', and 'Boundless' batteries tailored for diverse scenarios. The company integrates ESG principles and carbon management into its operations, aiming to lead industry innovation and support sustainable development and energy security.
